posts.author: GreenOx97
posts.body:
Hi
I'm looking for a plugin that I may have seen floating around before for MZ, but I can't be certain.
I need a plugin that lets me add a guest party member alongside my active party for certain battles. So, they would occupy a 5th slot in the party, act on their own, they wouldn't have a visible HP/MP gauge, and can't be given items.
I currently have HimeWorks guest followers plugin, but that only adds a party member in the map, not in battle (MV, but works perfectly well in MZ):
Guest Followers
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5ZJM4KXd19UIn RPG Maker, you have a party of actors.You can add actors to the party, or remove actors from the party at anytime. However, by default, all of th
himeworks.com
The closest example I can think of would be in Dragon Quest 11, where occasionally allies will jump in and help the party in special battles.
Does a plugin like that exist anywhere?

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
I don't know if such a plugin exists, but you can easily handle this with a plugin that simply increases the battleparty size to 5.
You would just have to check if a quest is active and if yes add the special actor if not keep the party at max 4 by eventing.
it does require more care during events, but is possible if you don't find a better solution.

posts.author: FrigidGaze
posts.body:
Hiya!
RPG Maker MZ comes by default with
'MenuSubMembersMZ.js' and 'SubMembersAttendBattle.js' in the dlc > Basic Resources > plugins folder when you install it on Steam and such.
These two plugins combined effectively let you emulate that Dragon Quest style of having a guest party that follows and can attack in battle without being targeted or having a status themselves like HP/MP in battle. And are visible following you on the map.
The only caveat is that they also display in the menu which might not be desired but you can cut that part out of the code quite neatly if you open MenuSubMembersMZ.js and remove everything that starts from 'add menu to window scene' down to the header for followers.
